note: Checkpoint E2 baseline: the mathematical FRONT-END (references, ranges, tokeniser, parser/AST-forms, SUM/SUMIF, comparison + SUMIF criteria, syntactic validation, linearity detection, linearisation, coefficient extraction) is now exercised DIRECTLY against the canonical production source engine/source/plumline-engine.js through the canonical harness (vm), not only against the legacy mirror engine/engine.js. E2 is structural and contractual: it changes NO engine byte, no parser, no operator, no literal, no error, no tolerance, no result, no order, no name, no parameter, no return, no logic. The engine SHA stays 5d68ed17...; engine/engine.js is untouched (consolidated only in a later phase). This fixture captures the PRE-E2 behaviour and is not regenerated during verify.

parity_matrix.note: Exact comparison runs WHERE the mirror exposes the same operation (direct) or through a shared public entry point (observable). engine/engine.js exports only 20 entry points; the pure front-end functions are not exported, so parity is anchored at loadGrid_ (direct) and detectModel_ (observable). detectModel_ is used ONLY as an observable E2/E3-boundary probe: NOT exposed through the E2 harness, NOT counted as a migrated E2 function, NOT the parser checker's authority.
parity_matrix.rule: a new divergence in any E2 case must fail; the mirror is never modified to force parity

migrated_suites.note: Audit by REAL call graph, not by suite name. harness.js run() calls detectModel_ AND solveModel_ end-to-end, so any suite built on run() reaches E3 model construction + solver and is NOT pure front-end. The E2 migration is the NEW canonical suites; the four legacy candidates stay legacy because migrating would force exposing detectModel_/solveModel_/readConstraint_.
